decision_conditions: Condition : 2 - The use as a control centre for taxi hire operations, with no customer waiting facilities or collection point, shall be carried on only by Mr Zakar Ali Waheed .

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - The use hereby permitted shall not be carried on between the hours of midnight and 0700 hours.
Condition : 5 - The premises shall not be used as a customer waiting area or collection point.
Condition : 6 - The premises shall not contain a drivers' rest room or any other facilities for drivers.
Condition : 7 - The display of advertisements for the taxi operations shall not take place outside the building known as 445b Great West Road.
description: Continued use of premises as a control centre for taxi hire operations.
